# Open choices: ci-pipeline

`aidd-team:ci-pipeline` leaves these decisions to the team. aidd's default holds until a `standards` entry fills one. `aidd standard list` names the library standards for each choice, and `aidd standard add` adopts one.

| Choice | Question | aidd's default | Options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `formatter` | Which formatter sets the layout of the code? | The ecosystem's common formatter, pinned, run in CI and in a pre-commit hook (`dev_basics`). | ruff format, Black, Prettier, Biome, gofmt, rustfmt |
| `linter` | Which linter checks the code? | The ecosystem's common linter, pinned, run in CI and in a pre-commit hook (`dev_basics`). | ruff, flake8, ESLint, Biome, Oxlint, golangci-lint, clippy |
| `type-checker` | Which type checker runs in CI? | The language's own strict type check, run in CI (`dev_basics`). | mypy, pyright, tsc --strict |
| `package-manager` | Which tool installs and locks the dependencies? | The ecosystem's standard package manager, with the lockfile committed. | uv, pip with pip-tools, Poetry, pnpm, npm, Cargo, Go modules |
| `test-runner` | Which test runner runs the unit and integration tests? | The ecosystem's common test runner, pinned, run in CI on every change. | pytest, Vitest, Jest, go test, cargo-nextest, JUnit, xUnit, flutter test |
| `dependency-audit` | Which audit of the locked dependencies runs next to OSV-Scanner? | None beyond OSV-Scanner, which the Dependency scan of `aidd-team:enterprise-controls` pins and runs over every lockfile. A standard that fills this choice adds the ecosystem's own audit. | OSV-Scanner alone, pip-audit, npm audit, govulncheck, cargo-deny |
| `language-version` | Which language and runtime version does the project target, and where is it pinned? | The newest release with long-term support (or the current stable release where there is no LTS), pinned in one file that CI and every developer read. | the latest LTS release, the current stable release, a declared minimum version (MSRV, requires-python) |
| `workspace` | Which workspace tool holds the apps, modules, and packages in one repository? | The package manager's own workspaces: one package per module, one lockfile, and one version of each dependency. Add a task runner only when builds need a cache. | the package manager's workspaces, a build tool's multi-project build, one package with a folder per module |
| `manifest-validation` | What checks the rendered Kubernetes manifests against the API schemas? | kubeconform in strict mode, against the Kubernetes version the cluster runs, on the manifests the deploy-packaging tool renders. | kubeconform, a server-side dry run against a cluster |
| `toolchain-manager` | Which tool installs the pinned runtimes and command-line tools on each machine and in CI? | mise, with exact versions in `mise.toml` and a `mise.lock` that records each download's checksum. A repository with one language may keep that language's own version file. | mise, the language's own version file, asdf, a dev container image |
